per-trait envelopes: [min, max] of log10 over benchmark DEV positives (data/trait-envelopes.v1.2.0.json; n >= 20 per trait); p = exp(-excess/0.05 decades)

lean_spec / flight claims accepted (design.lean_spec or opts.lean_spec) and run through lean_check; any accepted binding violation sets L = 0
invalid or refused designs (edits partedit/organism.mjs rejects) score 0.01, plausible false, never throw
rank_score: geometric mean of raw P parts x coverage factor, mean evidence; same weights; floor 1e-4

L from claims counts only accepted binding violations caused by the claim fields (full lean_spec minus the same spec without claim fields); morphology-only exponent rows that real specimens already violate against the single reference specimen do not count
